pull.title: KAFKA-21256: Fix reconciliation stalls in the Streams protocol client
pull.body:
Fixes KAFKA-21256.

An `onTasksAssigned` failure can leave the consumer assignment different
from `currentAssignment`. The next reconciliation throws and leaves the
progress flag set, blocking further attempts even when a new target
arrives.

This change tracks partial progress through three fields:
- `reconcilingAssignment`: captures the target being processed,
independently of newer assignments received during reconciliation.
- `appliedActiveTasks`: tracks active tasks already applied to the
consumer, separately from the last successfully reconciled assignment.
- `revokedTasksSinceApply`: tracks successful revocations since the last
assignment application, preventing duplicate revocation during retries
and leave. Applying an assignment clears this history.

Reconciliation can now retry the same target or process a newer target
using the actual consumer-applied state.  synchronous failures clear the
progress flag, and successful reconciliation clears pending revocation
flags.

### 🟢 Approval recommended There are no active review issues for the reconciliation recovery and partial-assignment tracking changes. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes reconciliation stalls in the Streams protocol client by tracking partially applied assignments separately from the last successful assignment, allowing retries after failures. **Changes:** - Track the in-progress target, consumer-applied active tasks, and completed revocations to support retries and group leave. - Reset reconciliation progress after synchronous failures and clear pending revocation flags after success. - Add regression tests for callback failures, changing targets, fencing, and leaving after partial progress. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `clients/​src/​test/​java/​org/​apache/​kafka/​clients/​consumer/​internals/​StreamsMembershipManagerReconciliationTest.java` | Adds regression coverage for reconciliation recovery and task cleanup. | | `clients/​src/​main/​java/​org/​apache/​kafka/​clients/​consumer/​internals/​SubscriptionState.java` | Adds support for clearing pending revocation flags. | | `clients/​src/​main/​java/​org/​apache/​kafka/​clients/​consumer/​internals/​StreamsMembershipManager.java` | Tracks partial reconciliation progress and updates retry and task-release handling. |
Review effort: Balanced

issue_comments.body:
@lucasbru Hi!
Sorry to bother you again 🙇‍♂️ 

Currently, in the Streams protocol client, if onTasksAssigned fails, the client fails to complete reconciliation and can become stuck in a state where it cannot recover naturally, even when the group epoch increases and a new assignment is received. As a result, the client remains stuck in this state indefinitely unless the Streams client is restarted.

When you have bandwidth, could you take a look? 🙇‍♂️

A label of 'needs-attention' was automatically added to this PR in order to raise the
attention of the committers. Once this issue has been triaged, the `triage` label
should be removed to prevent this automation from happening again.
